title: Hawaii's Big Island under rare hurricane landfall threat as Tropical Storm Lala strengthens
summary: Hawaii's Big Island faces an uncommon hurricane threat as Tropical Storm Lala intensifies, prompting hurricane and tropical storm warnings for the Big Island and Maui County as residents prepare for potential impact.
content: A hurricane warning was issued for the Big Island, and a tropical storm warning was in effect for Maui County.

zh.title: 随着热带风暴拉拉加强，夏威夷大岛面临罕见飓风登陆威胁
zh.summary: 随着热带风暴拉拉加强，夏威夷大岛面临罕见的飓风威胁，为大岛和毛伊县发布飓风和热带风暴警告，居民为潜在影响做准备。

title: Beijing is said to move to clarify tax rules stoking confusion among China's ultra-wealthy
summary: Chinese authorities are reportedly clarifying ambiguous new tax regulations on offshore trusts that have created confusion among wealthy individuals and financial advisors since the policy's recent implementation.
content: Beijing is said to be moving to clarify ambiguities in new tax rules on offshore trusts after the policy sowed confusion among wealthy Chinese and advisors.

zh.title: 北京据称将澄清引发中国超富群体困惑的税收规则
zh.summary: 据报道，中国当局正在澄清关于离岸信托的模糊新税收法规，这些法规自近期实施以来在富人和财务顾问中造成了困惑。

title: Russia's economy has defied the skeptics. Cracks are getting harder to hide
summary: Russia's wartime economy faces mounting pressure from a widening budget deficit, challenging earlier assessments of its economic resilience. Analysts warn that economic strain could intensify further next year, threatening the sustainability of its defense spending.
content: Russia's wartime economy is under growing strain as its budget deficit widens and analysts warn pressure could intensify next year.

zh.title: 俄罗斯经济出人意料，裂缝越来越难隐藏
zh.summary: 俄罗斯战时经济面临日益扩大的预算赤字压力，这与早期对其经济韧性的评估相悖。分析人士警告，经济压力可能在明年进一步加剧，威胁其国防支出的可持续性。

title: Extreme heat spurs earliest-ever Champagne harvest, putting its famous taste to the test
summary: Climate change has triggered the earliest Champagne harvest on record, forcing producers to preserve the wine's signature taste profile while contending with climate stress. The industry simultaneously battles tariff complications and declining consumer demand.
content: Producers of the iconic French fizz face a challenge to preserve its taste profile while they also battle tariff complications and fewer drinkers.

zh.title: 极端高温导致香槟创纪录最早采收，考验其著名口感
zh.summary: 气候变化引发了有记录以来最早的香槟采收，迫使生产商在应对气候压力的同时保持葡萄酒的标志性口感。该行业同时面临关税问题和消费者需求下降的困扰。
